items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: We used to go out there and make a big pot of gumbo and he'd get a big tub of soda water and beer, and we'd jam out there.

ctx.x: Nothing proved it. I believe it. And now we did, they had a little band, and on a Sunday afternoon after we met them, my wife and all, we used to go out here and he lives in St. Gable. We used to go out there and make a big pot of gumbo and he'd get a big tub of soda water and beer, and we'd jam out there. And we'd start, they were playing but I mean we'd.
Was Johnny Lucas ripping that little iron? Yeah, at that time, yeah. He had no Johnny Lucas at all.
